item.title: Mount Akagi & Lake Onuma: A Volcanic Crater Lake Above Maebashi — Guide
item.description: Mount Akagi, ranked among Japan’s 100 famous mountains, is a dormant volcanic complex rising above the Kanto plain, its multiple peaks encircling Lake Onuma, a crater lake formed within the volcano’s caldera. Hiking trails of varying difficulty wind across the peaks and around the lake, and each October the mountainside erupts in vivid crimson and gold as maple and other deciduous trees change colour, drawing large numbers of visitors to combine foliage viewing with a visit to the picturesque lakeside Akagi Shrine.
